5170.reason: PCr recovery half-time is ~20–30 s, so after near-complete depletion from very high-intensity exercise full resynthesis normally takes on the order of 3–5 minutes, i.e. about 4 minutes.

5171.reason: By 2020 (BSH/NHS practice), the old 30-minute start rule had been dropped; the evidence-based limit is that red-cell transfusion must be completed within 4 hours of leaving controlled storage, which is the deterioration window among these options.

5173.reason: Most primary hyperparathyroidism found on routine calcium testing is asymptomatic, whereas calcitonin lowers plasma calcium, vitamin D is not made by the parathyroids, and hypercalcaemia causes polyuria rather than oliguria.
